Thus the rest momentum matrix -M I is Hermitian while its real translation counterpart -iM I is skew-Hermitian; they are not asserted equal. The -2 mixed bracket consequently gives +2M at rest. Independently checked current producer Definition, seven-step Jacobi proof, contract and manifest, and consumer chain normalization -> chiral definition/identities -> producer.
